hypotheses.P0_full_layer1_path_is_directional: Replacing the full layer-1 product state from a positive-label donor into a same-current-token negative recipient increases the corresponding output-class score on at least 60% of held-out pairs.
hypotheses.P1_supervised_coalition_is_directional: The frozen rank-64 coalition increases the class score on at least 60% of pairs and exceeds a matched random support by at least 10 percentage points.
hypotheses.P2_coalition_tracks_full_path: Across pairs, the targeted coalition's class-score shift correlates at least 0.50 with the full layer-1 product-patch shift.
hypotheses.P3_coalition_beats_single_neuron: The rank-64 coalition has at least twice the mean absolute class-score effect of the best single supervised neuron.
hypotheses.P4_effect_is_not_only_extreme_selection: On the uniformly sampled half of pairs, the rank-64 coalition remains directionally correct on at least 55% and exceeds random support.
hypotheses.P5_endpoint_magnitude_is_upper_control: An endpoint-informed magnitude support is reported as a non-prospective upper control and is not used to select or interpret the supervised support.
